name: MailChimp
shortInfo: Mailchimp is an email marketing and marketing automation platform.
brief: Mailchimp Connector enables streaming relevant Mailchimp performance data into a user determined data warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
about: Get access to campaign reports and much more through this Mailchimp connector.
availableData:
[Automations](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/mailchimp/pipelines/automations.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a summary of the classic automations in your Mailchimp account.

[Campaigns](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/mailchimp/pipelines/campaigns.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the list of all campaigns in your Mailchimp account.

[Lists](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/mailchimp/pipelines/lists.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve information about all lists in your Mailchimp account.

[List’s Members](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/mailchimp/pipelines/lists-members.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the information about members in a specific Mailchimp list.

[Reports](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/mailchimp/pipelines/reports.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the campaign reports for all campaigns in your Mailchimp account.
